log_segment_size.name: log_segment_size
log_segment_size.description: The maximum size of a log segment file. When a segment file reaches this size, Redpanda closes it and creates a new segment.

enable_sasl.name: enable_sasl
enable_sasl.description: Enable SASL authentication for Kafka connections. When enabled, clients must authenticate using one of the configured SASL mechanisms.

retention_bytes.name: retention_bytes
retention_bytes.description: The maximum size of a partition's log before old segments are deleted. A value of -1 or `null` means no size-based retention limit. Can be overridden per topic.

cloud_storage_enabled.name: cloud_storage_enabled
cloud_storage_enabled.description: Enable Tiered Storage. When enabled, Redpanda can offload log segments to object storage.

kafka_connections_max.name: kafka_connections_max
kafka_connections_max.description: The maximum number of Kafka client connections allowed per broker. A value of `null` means unlimited connections.

group_max_session_timeout_ms.name: group_max_session_timeout_ms
group_max_session_timeout_ms.description: The maximum session timeout for consumer groups. If a consumer does not send a heartbeat within this time, it is considered dead and removed from the group. Works together with prop:log_segment_size[link=true] and the legacy config_ref:enable_sasl,true,cluster-properties[`enable_sasl`] form renders too.

redpanda.storage.mode.name: redpanda.storage.mode
redpanda.storage.mode.description:
The storage mode for a topic. Determines how topic data is stored and whether it is eligible for upload to object storage.

Accepted values:

* `local`: Topic data is stored only on the broker's local disk. Object storage upload is disabled for the topic, regardless of cluster-level Tiered Storage settings.
ifndef::env-cloud[]
* `tiered`: Topic data is stored on local disk and also uploaded to object storage. Enables xref:manage:tiered-storage/tiered-storage.adoc[Tiered Storage] for the topic.
* `cloud`: Topic data is stored in object storage using the xref:develop:manage-topics/cloud-topics/index.adoc[Cloud Topics] architecture. Local storage is used only as a write buffer.
endif::[]
ifdef::env-cloud[]
* `tiered`: Topic data is stored on local disk and also uploaded to object storage. Enables Tiered Storage for the topic.
* `cloud`: Topic data is stored in object storage using the Cloud Topics architecture. Local storage is used only as a write buffer.
endif::[]
* `unset`: Specifies that the topic's storage mode is unset, regardless of the cluster default. The topic may still have Tiered Storage enabled through the legacy properties `redpanda.remote.read` and `redpanda.remote.write`.

Starting in Redpanda v26.2, the `tiered` value is an alias that resolves to Tiered Storage v1 or v2 when the topic is created, according to the `default_redpanda_storage_mode_tiered_impl` cluster property. The resolved version is reported by the read-only <<redpandastoragemodeimpl,`redpanda.storage.mode.impl`>> property, and the storage mode of a topic displays as `tiered` for both versions.

This property overrides the cluster-wide `default_redpanda_storage_mode` setting for individual topics.

redpanda.remote.read.name: redpanda.remote.read
redpanda.remote.read.description: Enables reading data from object storage when Tiered Storage is enabled.

redpanda.storage.mode.impl.name: redpanda.storage.mode.impl
redpanda.storage.mode.impl.description: Read-only property reporting the resolved Tiered Storage implementation version (`tiered_v1` or `tiered_v2`) for a topic whose <<redpandastoragemode,`redpanda.storage.mode`>> is `tiered`.
